title: Dust and Thunder
blurb: Two nights of dust storm. The Mirage Mantis hunts in the haze and the Thunder Cicada's screech shatters lantern glass. Keep the lights burning on every cliff.

objective.text: Keep 4 Lantern Posts Burning on Every Cliff

telegram.title: Storm Warning
telegram.body: DUST STORMS BOTH NIGHTS STOP MIRAGE MANTIS AND THUNDER CICADA CLIMBING STOP LANTERNS KEEP THE MANTIS IN SIGHT STOP SCREECH BREAKS LANTERN GLASS STOP FOUR LANTERNS PER CLIFF AT EVERY DAWN STOP SPREAD YOUR TURRETS STOP

build: Dust storm rolling in. Four lanterns a cliff, burning at dawn. The Mantis hates the light.
Can't see my own cards in this. Finally, a fair game.
The Mantis bends light like a hot road. A lantern spoils the trick.
wave: Something's shimmering on the wall. Keep shooting the ripple!

build: Cicada's coming. Its screech cracks glass and rattles turrets stupid. Spread your guns out.
And the Mantis is back for seconds. Lanterns, ranchers. Lots of lanterns.
I'm taking bets on which one deafens us first.
wave: Hear that drumming? Here comes the thunder. Watch for the ring!

short: Lights are going out over there! Hang new lanterns before dawn.
boss_down: One down. Somebody owes me two bits.
win: Storm's blown out and the lamps are still lit. Fine work in the dark.
I heard the Queen stir below. That's... not ideal.
lost: Dawn came and the lights were out. We'll ride the storm again.

journal.title: Specimen Notes, No. 6
journal.body:
The storm bugs never come up in clear weather. They wait for dust the way men wait for payday.

Tonight the rails hummed from far below. Something very large is turning over in its sleep.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: Buttes Stay Lit Through Twin Storms
headline_loss: Thunder and Dust Blind the Buttes
